entities.name: UE Assistance Information Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE provides various assistance information to the network while in RRC_CONNECTED state

entities.name: UEAssistanceInformation message
entities.description: RRC message used by UE to transmit assistance information to the network

entities.name: delayBudgetReport
entities.description: Information element containing UE's delay budget report

entities.name: Timer T342
entities.description: Timer used to control transmission of UE assistance information

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an established RRC connection

entities.name: UE configured to provide assistance
entities.description: Condition where UE has been configured by network to provide specific assistance information

entities.name: Change in assistance information
entities.description: Condition where UE's assistance information preferences or status have changed

entities.name: First transmission condition
entities.description: Condition where UE has not transmitted the assistance information since being configured to provide it

relations.description: Procedure can only be initiated in RRC_CONNECTED state
